Himachal Pradesh High Court Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Himachal Pradesh High Court (Shimla) has released the Notification for the Various post Exam 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 388 posts. The online application process for Himachal Pradesh High Court Various Post Recruitment 2026 has Started on 10 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 10 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Himachal Pradesh High Court Various Post Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 August 2026
  • Last Date : 10 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For General : Rs. 450/-
  • For OBC, EWS, SC, ST & PH : Rs. 300/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
